title: 紅字
mood: quiet alarm you keep to yourself
subject: two numbers printed in red on a workplace health-check report
caption: New-Chinese rock with traditional instruments in the lead-voice role rather than as decoration. Erhu carrying the main melodic hook with its full bowed attack and slides, dizi bamboo flute answering it in the high register with audible breath, distorted electric guitars palm-muted underneath, hard rock drum kit with a tight snare, electric bass doubling the guitar root. Loud and dense, with the erhu and dizi mixed forward as the lead voices instead of buried under the guitars. Male voice, restrained and conversational in the verses, strained and pushed in the chorus. 142 BPM, D minor. Quiet alarm kept to yourself. No guzheng, no orchestral strings, no synth pad, no rapping, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - erhu and distorted guitar]

[Verse 1]
健檢報告寄到公司 行政小姐一張一張發
我的那張 有兩個紅字
我笑著收起來 跟她說謝謝
回到位子上 我把那張紙翻過來放

[Pre-Chorus]
紅字不大 比我的名字還小
但我整個下午 只看得到它

[Chorus]
三十五歲 第一次我的身體有話要跟我說
它不吵 它只是在紙上畫了兩條線
我一直以為我會先聽到警報
原來它是用這麼安靜的方式

[Verse 2]
晚上我查那兩個英文縮寫 查到凌晨
網路上什麼都有 最嚴重的最好看
我關掉手機 去廚房倒了一杯水
站在冰箱前面把它喝完 這是今天我唯一做對的事

[Chorus]
三十五歲 第一次我的身體有話要跟我說
它不吵 它只是在紙上畫了兩條線
我一直以為我會先聽到警報
原來它一直都在用這麼安靜的方式

[Instrumental Break - erhu solo over guitars]

[Outro - band cuts]
那張紙 我放在皮夾裡
不是提醒 是收據
